related.title: WebGPU 瀏覽器AI：workgroup限制與回退
related.titleEn: WebGPU browser AI: workgroup limits and fallback
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：無使用已釋放緩衝，初末複製可見，CPU/GPU結果在容差內。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: No freed-buffer use, endpoint copies are visible, and outputs agree within tolerance.
related.difference: 以實際adapter限制選tile，對缺少能力或device lost提供可用回退。
related.differenceEn: Choose tiles from actual adapter limits and handle unavailable features or device loss with fallback.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 同裝置連續步驟可共享駐留張量；初次與最後傳輸仍需計入。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 10次裝置計算各1 ms；傳入與傳出各0.5 ms，未綁定時每次都搬移。 未綁定=10×(1+0.5+0.5)=20 ms。
兩個B×B FP32輸入tile需8B² bytes workgroup儲存；此預算不含其他共享變數。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學adapter可用共享容量16 KiB，B32，每元素4 bytes，工作組執行緒數另檢查。 需要8×32²/1024=8 KiB，尚餘8 KiB；不能由容量通過推論執行緒限制也通過。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Consecutive same-device steps can retain tensors; initial and final transfers remain. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Ten device steps1 ms each; upload/download0.5 ms each, repeated every step without binding. Unbound total=10×(1+0.5+0.5)=20 ms.

TwoB×B FP32 tiles require8B² bytes of workgroup storage, excluding other shared variables. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching adapter storage 16 KiB, B32, 4 bytes/value; thread-count limits are checked separately. Storage 8 KiB, leaving8 KiB; capacity passing does not establish thread-count validity.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Safetensors 模型交付：分塊續傳與完整性
related.titleEn: Safetensors delivery: chunked resume and integrity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：無使用已釋放緩衝，初末複製可見，CPU/GPU結果在容差內。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: No freed-buffer use, endpoint copies are visible, and outputs agree within tolerance.
related.difference: 區分格式安全、檔案完整性、來源可信與使用授權，不將檔名或雜湊當成全部信任。
related.differenceEn: Separate format safety, integrity, provenance and authorization rather than trusting filenames or hashes alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 同裝置連續步驟可共享駐留張量；初次與最後傳輸仍需計入。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 10次裝置計算各1 ms；傳入與傳出各0.5 ms，未綁定時每次都搬移。 未綁定=10×(1+0.5+0.5)=20 ms。
固定分塊傳輸只重送缺少或校驗失敗的塊；完整檔雜湊需在重組後再次核對。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學模型8192 MiB，塊64 MiB，共128塊，連線有效速率32 MiB/s，忽略協定開銷。 全量理想時間8192/32=256 s；雜湊計算及伺服器確認另計。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Consecutive same-device steps can retain tensors; initial and final transfers remain. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Ten device steps1 ms each; upload/download0.5 ms each, repeated every step without binding. Unbound total=10×(1+0.5+0.5)=20 ms.

Fixed-chunk resume retransmits missing/corrupt chunks; the reconstructed whole-file digest is checked again. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching model8192 MiB, 64 MiB chunks, 128 chunks, effective32 MiB/s, excluding protocol overhead. Full ideal transfer256 s, with hashing and server confirmation additional.
